items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: he used the term, it was us... George or Jim or Henry

ctx.x: No, he was just a fella that had the Indiana Trucks I told ya. He took it upon himself to take us around to different parties. He wanted them to hear us entertain. You understand? And through him was a great movement because his saying nigger didn't mean nothing, 'cause we knew he was white, we knew he was white. What he was saying didn't mean nothing. You understand? What meant something was him telling this other white fella who he had that the word when he used it wasn't as harmful to us as it would be

to George and Jim. You get my point? Therefore, they received us knowing that we know who we are without them saying who we were. And they don't have to bring up the term at all, 'cause he's already introduced us as being one of us -- us -- he used the term, it was us.
